content: Hello, I would like to place a delivery order, please.
Welcome to Karachi Kitchen. What can I get for you?
I would like to order two chicken biryanis for delivery, and please make them less spicy if possible. Also, do you have raita?
Yes, we have raita. We can make the biryani less spicy for you. So that's two less spicy chicken biryanis and one raita. Anything else?
No, that's everything. Could you please tell me how much the delivery fee and tax are, and if you have any minimum order?
There is no minimum order. Delivery is an additional one hundred and fifty rupees. There is no tax.
That is fine. What is your delivery fee and tax, and do you have a minimum order?
There is no minimum order and no tax. The delivery fee is one hundred and fifty rupees.
Could you please tell me what the total comes to, and how long delivery will take? Also, my address is House 12, Street 4, F-7/2, Islamabad, and my callback number is 0300-0000000.
